title: metadata-types: is_vendor_namespace accepts non-DNS chars
description: crate-jmap-metadata-types/src/namespace.rs is_vendor_namespace accepts any is_ascii_graphic byte in a label, so 'acme.example.com/k', 'a.b~c' or 'a.b"x' count as valid namespace identifiers. draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-04 §2.1 (L341-347): a domain name 'in DNS form', 'Domain-name identifiers MUST be in lowercase, with internationalized labels in A-label form'; '/' in particular collides with /set patch paths and /get subselectors (§3.1 L487-491). Effect today: Foo/set complete-replacement keys like {"a.b/c": {}} pass check_metadata_write in every server; jmap-mail-server's /get subselector parser guards '/' locally (helpers.rs MetadataProjection::new, JMAP-s4kp.8). Fix: restrict labels to LDH (lowercase letters, digits, hyphen; no leading/trailing hyphen), then drop the local guard.
